_readme: Edit this file with YOUR numbers, then run: python3 tools/make_comparison.py . Tags: V = published by the vendor, M = measured by us, E = estimate / not verified.

published_wer_percent._source: Confucius4-R2T2 README, English table (WER %, lower is better). Clean/meeting/TED/earnings-call test sets, NOT church audio.

rhemaflow_tiny_en_wer_estimate_source: docs/ACCURACY.md, an ESTIMATE, not measured on a pulpit

rhemaflow_measured_accuracy_percent._source: MEASURED in the build sandbox: one clip (JFK, 11 s), Whisper tiny.en, AGC -> VAD -> Whisper. One speaker, steady synthetic noise / chord-bed music. Says nothing about 93%.

scorecard.why: R2T2 publishes 93.9% average; tiny.en is a 39 M-parameter model, est. 86-91% (not measured on a pulpit)

R2T2 only appends (seen in the demo). Ours now shows permanent (solid) words only after two decodes agree; on 14 REAL recorded Whisper decodes committed words never changed. Cost: in noise one wrong word stayed ('And' for 'Ask'), reported honestly
R2T2 claims 200-600 ms on a GPU; on an M1 we estimate 0.5-1 s; Whisper path simulated at 0.35-0.9 s
R2T2 publishes no noise number (demo page not opened); ours held 95-100% on one clip with synthetic noise/music; real music is harder
our auto-volume took a very quiet mic from 50% to 95.5%
ours cuts at breaths every ~12 s and loses nothing, but text arrives in pieces
nobody measured here; the bigger multilingual model is expected to cope better
R2T2 only transcribes (book names can be hinted); RhemaFlow parses, fuzzy-matches books, snaps quotes, 83 tests
R2T2 is ~2 B parameters and built for a CUDA GPU; our default is a 75 MB model
ours has watchdogs, reconnects, tests; with R2T2 the built-in Whisper now takes over if the stream is down or silent (failover logic unit-tested, not run on a Mac)

scorecard.category: Easy for a volunteer to install
scorecard.why: R2T2: Python + GPU; ours: one script (sidecar setup not yet run on a Mac)
all can run on the local machine
R2T2 is multilingual (code-switching shown in the demo); tiny.en is English only
